svg.aria-label: Full stack engineering. Frontend: React, Next.js and Angular with TypeScript. Architecture: microservices connected with Kafka, SQS, SNS, EventBridge and Lambda. APIs: REST and GraphQL secured with Spring Security and JWT, documented with Swagger. Payments: Stripe, PayPal, Payzone and Naps. Domains: booking and property management, vehicle marketplace, garage management, affiliate comparison.
